position_rules: BIP39 entropy and checksum lengths; mnemonic+optional NFKD passphrase derive a seed. Only vocabulary/general family is mapped, no wallet-specific path.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported recovery passphrase and derivation path stay outside Tessaveil. Local encryption/unlock passwords are distinct.

semantic_distinction: Official docs describe external BIP39-to-hex conversion for native wallet restoration. This is not direct Decrediton BIP39 generation/import and not Cake15. Exact hardware/product recovery remains unverified.
